method: MODIS MCD12Q1 land cover (500 m, IGBP classes), read in 2001, 2008, 2016 and 2023: pixels vegetated in 2001 that turned to bare ground and stayed bare at every later reading; neighbouring pixels form a patch, patches of fewer than 2 pixels are dropped.
cannot_see: Minerals themselves: rare earths or any deposit underground leave no mark in climate, rain, plant or land-cover data. Finding them needs geological maps or a mineral-mapping instrument (NASA EMIT, ASTER). Mines smaller than a few hectares, and mines under forest canopy, are below what 500 m pixels resolve.
